comments.author: @stevesellers4107
comments.text:
rents in the DR vary greatly depending on which area and what is included...I have had a nice newly renovated large 2 bedroom, fully furnished ,   apartment in a small gated area with 24/7 security for a little under $ 1,100 ( cdn ) it only had basic wifi ( which I upgraded for an additional 1500 peso) nice swimming pool ,5 min walk up the hills above Sosua.Of course electricity  ( Very comparable to what I pay in Canada) and bottled water are extra. Perhaps I was getting a break on the rent as I was there for 2-3 months..Food is definitely on the up swing..if you plan to eat  out a lot ...be prepared to pay a lot more in your budget. Gypsy cabs, Guagaus and Moto concho are good enough to get more close to the real Dominican Vibe..I really do hope the Locals ( both Dominican and Haitians)..can still make a decent living after that "Operation Atlantico " fiasco
Oh ...almost forgot going to try to downsize this winter  ...renting a 1 bedroom fully furnished gated in the heart of the town for almost the same price  ( with some other extras included )....will give it a try and see how I like it  I have stayed in this same area for the last 8 years so I do know a little bit about the area  ..you cannot compare Puerto Plata and area to Santo Domingo or Santiago...that would be like trying to compare Caberete to Sosua.....here's a tip...if you have a pool and screens on your doors and windows...open them up and the breeze across the pool will help you stay cool..( a little pun there but it works).
🍸
